72f8a9a0.text: The Phoenix project was committed at six weeks of engineering and shipped in nine. The three-week slip is the *deliverable* the team has to learn from — the codebase is fine, the architecture is fine,

3285f2af.text: **Underestimated cache eviction work (+9 days).** The eviction policy turned out to need a per-tenant override layer; that layer was not in the original spec.

81e90bf9.text: The override layer surfaced when a single big-tenant migration triggered an eviction storm during staging load tests.

a53b035a.text: The fix required a small allocator change *and* an operational runbook — neither of which was scoped.

6ea34583.text: **Under-tested deploy automation (+5 days).** The new deploy pipeline worked in the dev environment but the prod pipeline needed a manual approval step we had not budgeted for.

642a15ce.text: **Late-discovered cross-service dependency (+4 days).** The search service had been relying on an undocumented quirk of the old cache; removing the quirk meant a coordinated cut-over.

991d9626.text: **Holiday season throughput drop (+3 days).** Two team members on planned PTO during the third week; estimable, but the buffer in the schedule did not cover it.
